title: Honoring Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month
description:
March is Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month, and the City of San Diego is proud to support our community through Therapeutic Recreation Services. 💛 

From exciting outings to creative activities and social events at our recreation centers, we’re committed to providing inclusive spaces where everyone can connect. For program information, visit sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/activities/trs.
